_comment: Painting (2026-09-14): at full stretch (top of the paper, shoulder_lift 80-110) the arm carries 400-420 on shoulder_lift and sags 3.5-4.5 deg at P=32 -> LOAD GUARD and STALL tripped mid-program. Stiffer shoulder, wider stall band; the load and floor guards still protect the table. Lifting a wet brush out of the far blue pan (lift ~81, elbow ~-3) read 488 -> 600. Lifting out at the far top edge of the paper at 9-12 deg/s: 608-640 -> 750 (the reading is PWM effort, mostly gravity; elbow/wrist load, stall and floor guards are unchanged).
_cams: 2026-11-13: cameras picked by model + position ('Innomaker#n' = n-th Innomaker in OpenCV order, which sorts by uniqueID). Laptop/OBS cameras are never opened. Both Innomakers share one USB serial: after a reconnect the bridge checks which view moves with the arm (CAM_ON_ARM) and swaps them if needed, so any USB ports work. Manual: the lab camera panel's Swap button. List: uv run python -m so101_bridge.camera_ids
